verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud documents a live preview and a `live_view_url` that let a human watch the browser and take control. The documented flows are CAPTCHA fallback and a planned 2FA checkpoint, where the run is asked to stop and the same session then continues. There is no documented live takeover of a running agent at the moment it gets stuck. missing for 10: documented takeover of a run in progress with pause/resume of the agent, handback semantics after human intervention, a general stuck-agent intervention flow beyond CAPTCHA/2FA, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can watch a session live and take human control mid-run when the agent gets stuck

citations.quote: If the challenge remains, open the [live preview](/cloud/browser/live-preview) for human control.
Ask the first run to stop at the 2FA screen, get its `live_view_url` from the [`browser.ready` event], and have the user enter the code. Then continue with the same session
The most reliable options are a saved profile or a human checkpoint.
